recipe.name: Nutty Port Manhattan
recipe.description: A rich and complex twist on a Manhattan that pairs smoky Scotch with nutty hazelnut, herbal rosemary, and a velvety spiced foam header.
steps: Muddle the rosemary sprig gently in a mixing glass to release its herbal aromas.
Add Dewar's White Label, hazelnut syrup, and Ruby Port into the mixing glass.
Fill the mixing glass with ice and stir until well chilled.
Double strain the liquid into a chilled coupe glass.
Top the cocktail with a delicate layer of spiced foam.
recipe.serving: Served chilled in a coupe topped with spiced foam
